105:t_1:86.en:
$n
「I was just thinking about $$宗介$$ and the others who went to $$翠の地球$$.」

105:t_1:87.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Well, well... You're a loyal friend.」

105:t_1:88.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's happening again... Whenever his mother comes up, $n goes back to his old self...)

105:t_1:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
($$ガドライト・メオンサム$$'s last words... What on earth did they mean...?)

105:t_1:93.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$　$$スメラギ$$'s Quarters～

105:t_1:94.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...I can understand why $$サイデリアル$$ seized $$ヴェーダ$$, a cornerstone of Earth's defense...)

105:t_1:95.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(They will probably analyze $$ヴェーダ$$ and use its power to bolster their forces.)

105:t_1:96.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(But if $$サイデリアル$$ analyzes $$ヴェーダ$$'s deepest levels, which even $$ティエリア$$ couldn't access...)

105:t_1:97.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(They may discover $$ヴェーダ$$'s true meaning...)

105:t_1:98.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(《$$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$》 and 《$$エルガン・ローディック$$》... Looking back, those two probably had some connection to $$クロノ$$...)

105:t_1:99.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$イノベイター$$s are humanity's innovators... If $$イオリア$$ foresaw their existence, might he have been a member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...?)

105:t_1:100.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I'm sorry to disturb your rest. We've received an urgent encrypted transmission.」

105:t_1:101.en:
$$フェルト$$
「It's from Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$ of the $$地球連邦軍$$.」

105:t_2:4.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$刹那$$...! And $$バナージ$$! $$タクヤ$$ and $$ミコット$$ too!」

105:t_2:6.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You're a tough survivor, just as I'd expect from a former $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ member!」

105:t_2:7.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Not really. If you hadn't come, I don't know what would have happened to me.」

105:t_2:8.en:
$$ミコット$$
「But I'm glad you're safe, $$沙慈$$.」

105:t_2:9.en:
$n
「Seeing $$刹那$$ like that, I don't feel like calling him the quiet type.」

105:t_2:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Of course. To $$刹那$$, $$沙慈$$ is a friend more than a comrade.」

105:t_2:11.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You make that same face when you're with the Volunteer Club.」

105:t_2:14.en:
$$イアン$$
「Yes, yes. That's youth for you.」

105:t_2:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Then $$ルイス$$ is still in Japan?」

105:t_2:16.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Her symptoms have settled down a lot. But I thought she should stay close to her doctor.」

105:t_2:17.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$沙慈$$, did you go down to Earth right after we got separated at $$インダストリアル７$$?」

105:t_2:18.en:
$$沙慈$$
「A lot happened after that... I think I finally saw $$ルイス$$ around August last year...」

105:t_2:19.en:
$$ミコット$$
「You were a member of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too, $$沙慈$$. You could have joined $c...」

105:t_2:20.en:
$$沙慈$$
「My fight is to protect $$ルイス$$. I decided to leave protecting the world to $$刹那$$ and the others.」

105:t_2:21.en:
$$刹那$$
「You made the right choice. You should fight your own battle.」

105:t_2:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
($$沙慈$$ really is a special friend to $$刹那$$...)

105:t_2:23.en:
$$沙慈$$
「But with things like this, it wasn't easy to find work...」

105:t_2:24.en:
$$沙慈$$
「In the end, I used President $$ミレイ$$'s connections and found work in the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$.」

105:t_2:25.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「President $$ミレイ$$... You knew her when you went to $$アッシュフォード学園$$, right?」

105:t_2:26.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Yeah. I still keep in touch with my friends from back then.」

105:t_2:27.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Oh, $$刹那$$... Do you know where $$ルルーシュ$$, $$スザク$$, and $$カレン$$ are?」

105:t_2:28.en:
$$刹那$$
「They're fighting to defend $$新日本$$ from the $$新地球皇国$$.」

105:t_2:29.en:
$$沙慈$$
「I see... That place is important to $$ルルーシュ$$ and the others too.」

105:t_2:31.en:
$$沙慈$$
「I'll go back to town. It's been badly damaged, but my workplace is there.」

105:t_2:32.en:
$$沙慈$$
「It's a small transport company, but the head office also runs regular flights to space.」

105:t_2:34.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You haven't forgotten your dream of working in space either, $$沙慈$$.」

105:t_2:35.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Of course not. Working hard there is part of my battle too.」

105:t_2:37.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Your fate has started moving, $$バナージ$$.」

105:t_2:39.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「And it dragged $$ミコット$$ and me along too.」

105:t_2:40.en:
$$ミコット$$
「But don't worry about it. We chose to go with you ourselves, $$バナージ$$.」

105:t_2:42.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$刹那$$... Can I ask you to look after $$バナージ$$ and the others?」

105:t_2:44.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Let's meet again, $$刹那$$. Next time, $$ルイス$$ will be with us too.」

105:t_2:45.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll fight so that we can see that day.」

105:t_2:46.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「...Friendship is a good thing.」

105:t_2:47.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In your case, Lieutenant, isn't romance more important?」

105:t_2:48.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You shouldn't weigh friendship against love. They're equally important.」

105:t_2:49.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Listen to you, Happy $$コーラサワー$$.」

105:t_2:50.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Thanks for your cooperation, $c. I thank you on behalf of the Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General.」

105:t_2:51.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Give my regards to $$カティ$$, Mr. $$マネキン$$.」

105:t_2:52.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「...I've been wondering for a while. You knew the Colonel when she was a student, didn't you, $$スメラギ$$?」

105:t_2:53.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Yes... There's an age gap, but we were friends.」

105:t_2:54.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Next time we meet, I'd like you to tell me all about those days.」

105:t_2:55.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Of course. I'm curious about $$カティ$$'s married life too.」

105:t_2:58.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Thanks for covering me today. You really helped me out.」

105:t_2:59.en:
$n
「No... I should be thanking you. Your techniques gave me a lot to learn from, Lieutenant.」

105:t_2:60.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You two get along pretty well.」

105:t_2:61.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「It's probably because they both like older beauties with glasses, right?」

105:t_2:62.en:
$$イアン$$
「That's bad news. I can't let them meet $$リンダ$$.」

105:t_2:63.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You two get along well too...」

105:t_2:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Huh... Did the Nurse... wear glasses?」

kept_omissions: 105:t_1:96: Sumeragi leaves the conditional unfinished at the row boundary; next row gives the potential discovery.
